title: A/R: a document dated on the as-of date counts, one dated after does not
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has an open invoice created on date D (any past day).
  • Customer X also has an unused credit memo created on day D + 1.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to day D.
  4. Open every bucket.
  5. Look for customer X's invoice.
  6. Look for customer X's credit memo.
  7. Set the date chip to the day before D.
  8. Open every bucket.
  9. Look for customer X's invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • the invoice created on day D is listed.

Step 6:

  • the credit memo created on D + 1 is not listed.

Step 9:

  • on the day before D the invoice is not listed.

Why this matters: The as-of date must include the whole chosen day and nothing later, or month-end figures are wrong.
